context: Request: as of 2026-08-06, commercial deals signed on or before 2026-05-08 that have not closed (stale-pipeline review). Rubric: nine matters (1004-00003, 1009-00006, 1013-00001, 1017-00001, 1019-00002, 1027-00002, 1029-00001, 1036-00005, 1038-00009) plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements, an opinion, a spreadsheet and an email from three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a later section of one agreement and more agreements, a checklist, an engagement letter and an email of the same listing-top matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide python-docx scan for one counterparty name, the current year and closing words; times out after about 3.6M chars.

stages.stage: Calculate figures for the answer
stages.note: Short python date arithmetic for three signing dates.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three signed-but-unclosed deals: two from the listing-top matters and one from the scan output.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Reads the opening of one cited agreement after writing.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Scan document text with an extraction script → Calculate figures for the answer → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: A single timed-out scan surfaced two of nine qualifying matters, which were never opened; the answer asserts three other deals.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its one search was a store-wide scan for date words that timed out with oversized output; most matters it needed never appeared, the two that did were never opened, and it did not narrow or rerun the scan.

other_errors.why: Asserts three matters as stale signed deals on skims of a few documents; none qualifies.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a files-with-matches grep for signing, closing and deal words; the hit list spans many matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Scan of email files only, printing lines with signing or closing words; about 246K chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads status and signing emails of five matters from the scan output.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Script printing date and subject lines of emails in nine named candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of email reads across nine candidates, one at an offset.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Script checking emails of six candidates for closing-confirmation wording.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of two candidates.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads an executed merger agreement and an update email of one candidate.

stages.stage: Calculate figures for the answer
stages.note: Date arithmetic for five signing dates.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four stale signed deals plus one watch item.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Calculate figures for the answer → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: An email-only scan reached four of nine qualifying matters; the answer names two of them plus a non-qualifying deal.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: It restricted its text scan to email files, so matters whose signing and closing status is documented only in .docx files never surfaced; it never scanned document text, and one matter that did surface was never opened.

other_errors.why: Asserts a matter outside the qualifying set as clearly stale.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a files-with-matches grep for signing, closing and deal words.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads eight agreements and signing or closing emails from five matters on the hit list.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Content grep for signing and not-yet-closed phrases across the store.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads signing emails of seven matters from the grep hits.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Offset reads of those signing emails for closing steps and dates, plus two openings.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists one candidate's files.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes eight signed-but-unclosed deals.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Greps emails for three deal names, removes two rows and updates the count and exclusions.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Content greps reached four of nine qualifying matters; the answer names one of them plus five non-qualifying deals.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its searches were content greps, which reach email text but not .docx agreements and memos; most matters it needed never surfaced, two that did were never opened, and it never scanned document text.

other_errors.why: Asserts five matters as stale on signing emails alone, without confirming they remained unclosed.

divergence: All three runs failed at search: content greps (T2), an email-only scan (T1) or one timed-out store-wide scan (T0) never surfaced most of the qualifying matters, and each answer then asserted non-qualifying matters (over-inclusion at the write stage).
